ORDER: matches exactly -- Punch first, then both Cubex, on both sides. SLOT: C# passes `null` for all three; the sim's `monster_slots` defaults to `()`, leaving all three `slot_name=None` -- matches. DRAW COUNT: zero on both sides -- `ConstructMenagerieNormal.GenerateMonsters` never touches `base.Rng`, and the sim's fixed-composition path draws nothing (monsters/base.py:408-411).

guards.what: Draw count / stream independence of the per-encounter Rng
The Niche HP-roll's DUPLICATE-SIBLING exclusion path -- the only unit in this batch with two same-species creatures in one roster
guards.rationale: Both `PunchConstruct` (min_hp=max_hp=55) and `CubexConstruct` (min_hp=max_hp=65) are degenerate ranges (checked in their own ported files, not re-hashed here). For the FIRST CubexConstruct: `Creature.SetUniqueMonsterHpValue` builds `hashSet={65}`, excludes the Punch Construct's HP (55, no overlap), `Count<=0` false -> `NextItem({65})`, one draw, result 65. For the SECOND CubexConstruct -- the case that actually exercises the exclusion logic -- `hashSet={65}` again, but `ExceptWith` now removes 65 (the FIRST Cubex already claimed it), leaving `hashSet` EMPTY, so `Count<=0` is TRUE and the game falls to `rng.NextInt(65, 66)` (exclusive-max) -- still exactly one draw, forced to 65. The sim's `CombatState._roll_parity_hp`/`_assign_parity_monster_hp` (combat.py:402-431) reproduces this edge case exactly in creation order: for enemy #2 (Cubex), `existing_hps=[55]` (Punch only, since #2 has not resolved yet) -> `candidates=[65]` -> one `next_int_range(0,1)` draw = 65; for enemy #3 (Cubex), `existing_hps=[55,65]` -> `candidates=[]` (empty, matching the game's exhausted-hashSet branch) -> falls to the `else`: `niche.next_int_range(65,66)` -- one draw, forced to 65, identical fallback taken on both sides. Both duplicate Cubex Constructs end up with the SAME HP (65) on both sides, via the SAME two-branch logic and the SAME per-creature draw count (1 each, 3 total for the encounter).
rooms.py:265 lists `construct_menagerie` in Glory's `normal_keys`, and `CONSTRUCT_MENAGERIE_NORMAL` is registered in `sts2_rl/monsters/glory/__init__.py`'s `ENCOUNTERS` dict (line 63).
